items.title: Intel's AI PCs are selling, but the wider PC recovery is still missing
items.summary: Intel's growing AI PC sales are coexisting with a shrinking PC market, as memory constraints weaken purchases and computer makers reduce processor inventories. The distinction matters for the company's manufacturing response: a better product mix can support Intel's position without restoring overall PC demand, while capacity released by weaker client sales takes time to become server supply.
